title: coord.py serve scopes keys by team: key files <keys>/<team>/<operator>, team-named events and holders
goal: coord.py serve reads key files as <keys>/<team>/<operator> beside flat <keys>/<operator> files; a caller's claim or put of a key under another team's team/<name>/ prefix is refused, exit 1, while its own team's keys and every other key stay open; events carry operator <team>/<operator> and a served claim's holder starts with it

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile, json
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("GIT_", "KB_", "CLAUDE"))}
ENV.update(GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM="1", KB_LIVE_DOCS="0", KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite"),
           GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="t", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="t@example.com", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="t", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="t@example.com")
def g(*a, cwd):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, env=ENV, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
def run(*a, env=None, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env or ENV, cwd=cwd, timeout=300)
def art(root_dir, rel, title, fact, sid):
    p = os.path.join(root_dir, rel); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True)
    topic = rel[:-3]
    open(p, "w").write(f"---\ntopic: {topic}\npriority: P3\napplies_to: \"x\"\nretrieved_utc: 2026-10-19\nsources: [{sid}]\nstatus: complete\n---\n\n# {title}\n\n## Summary\n{fact}\n\n## Facts\n- {fact} [DOC {sid}]\n\n## Reference\n\n## Examples\n")
def make_root(path, name, prefix, vis, sid, rel, title, fact):
    os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(path, "_root.md"), "w").write(f"---\nroot: {name}\nid_prefix: {prefix}\nvisibility: {vis}\ndescription: {name}\n---\n\n# {name}\n")
    open(os.path.join(path, "_sources.csv"), "w").write("id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by\n"
        f"{sid},https://example.com/{name},{name} doc,Example,MIT,copy,2026-10-19,v1,,,\n")
    art(path, rel, title, fact, sid)
# C: a throwaway clone made of this checkout's tools and a planted kb with a public root
C = os.path.join(T, "clone")
shutil.copytree("_tools", os.path.join(C, "_tools"), ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc", "fixtures"))
make_root(os.path.join(C, "kb", "public"), "public", "S", "public", "S-aaaaaaaa", "planted/win32-packaging.md", "Win32 apps",
          "Intune deploys Win32 apps packaged with the content prep tool")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_self"), exist_ok=True)
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main", C, cwd=T); g("add", "-A", cwd=C); g("commit", "-qm", "base", cwd=C)
# O: a team's knowledge repository as a local bare repository
TS, O = os.path.join(T, "team-src"), os.path.join(T, "team-a.git")
make_root(TS, "team-a", "TA", "internal", "TA-aaaaaaaa", "mdm/enrolment.md", "Enrolment runbook",
          "Team A enrols kiosks through the PL-SRV-0042 enrolment profile")
g("init", "-q", "-b", "main", TS, cwd=T); g("add", "-A", cwd=TS); g("commit", "-qm", "team", cwd=TS)
g("init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O, cwd=T); g("push", "-q", O, "main", cwd=TS)
TOOLS = os.path.join(C, "_tools")
def pointer(name, prefix, url, access="fetch", vis="internal", team=None, pin="", ref="main"):
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_roots"), exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(C, "kb", "_roots", name + ".md"), "w").write(
        f"---\nroot: {name}\nid_prefix: {prefix}\nvisibility: {vis}\nteam: {team or name}\nurl: {url}\nref: {ref}\npin: {pin}\naccess: {access}\ndescription: {name}\n---\n")
def team_commit(text, msg):
    art(TS, "mdm/enrolment.md", "Enrolment runbook", text, "TA-aaaaaaaa")
    g("commit", "-qam", msg, cwd=TS); g("push", "-q", O, "main", cwd=TS)
    return g("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=TS).strip()
FILEOK = dict(ENV, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT="1", GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0="protocol.file.allow", GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="always")
PACK = lambda q, env=None: run(os.path.join(TOOLS, "rag.py"), "pack", q, env=env)
KQ = "team a enrols kiosks enrolment profile"

import time
K = os.path.join(T, "keys")
for rel, tok in (("team-a/jan", "tok-a-0123456789abcdef"), ("team-b/ola", "tok-b-0123456789abcdef"), ("solo", "tok-s-0123456789abcdef")):
    p = os.path.join(K, rel); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p), exist_ok=True); open(p, "w").write(tok + "\n"); os.chmod(p, 0o600)
    kf = os.path.join(T, rel.replace("/", "_") + ".key"); open(kf, "w").write(tok + "\n"); os.chmod(kf, 0o600)
S = os.path.join(T, "served.sqlite")
P = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "_tools/coord.py", "--store", S, "serve", "--bind", "127.0.0.1:0", "--keys", K], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env=ENV)
try:
    url = P.stdout.readline().strip().split()[-1]
    def c(key, *a):
        r = run("_tools/coord.py", "--url", url, "--key-file", os.path.join(T, key + ".key"), *a)
        return r.returncode, json.loads(r.stdout or "{}")
    code, b = c("team-a_jan", "claim", "team/team-a/x", "--ttl", "60", "--holder", "w1")
    assert code == 0, ("a team-a operator cannot claim its own team key", code, b)
    code, b = c("team-a_jan", "get", "team/team-a/x")
    assert b.get("holder", "").startswith("team-a/jan"), ("the holder does not name team and operator", b)
    code, b = c("team-b_ola", "claim", "team/team-a/y", "--ttl", "60")
    assert code == 1, ("a team-b operator may claim a team-a key", code, b)
    code, b = c("team-b_ola", "claim", "research:public/planted/win32-packaging:ime", "--ttl", "60")
    assert code == 0, ("a shared key is refused", code, b)
    code, b = c("solo", "claim", "research:public/x:y", "--ttl", "60")
    assert code == 0, ("a flat key file no longer works", code, b)
    code, b = c("team-a_jan", "post", "--kind", "heartbeat", "--field", "item=ST-aaaaaaaa")
    code, b = c("team-a_jan", "wait", "--since", "0", "--timeout", "1")
    ops = [e.get("fields", e).get("operator") for e in b.get("events", [])]
    assert "team-a/jan" in ops, ("events do not carry operator team-a/jan", b)
finally:
    P.kill()
